name: B10-0498/2026 (Renew) – Ukrainian children forcibly deported to Russia or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to stop deporting Ukrainian children and to return them. It says these deportations are war crimes and may amount to genocide. It asks Russia to hand over full lists of the children and let aid groups reach them. It wants the European Union to widen sanctions, keep funding rescue groups, and make any peace deal include the children's return. This is the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament urges wider sanctions, more funding for rescue groups, and child-return terms in any peace deal.
- **Who it affects:** Deported Ukrainian children, their families, Russia, Belarus, North Korea, and European Union governments.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to European Union governments, Russia, the United Nations and others. Governments decide whether to act.
